land_mask.source: Task 7 OSM coastline-derived land mesh, LOD 0

channels.R: positive depth metres mapped to 0–64 m (about 0.25 m per code value)
channels.G: valid water coverage; 255 valid, 0 land/no-data/outside coverage

gpu_depth_texture.filtering: GPU linear filtering; validity channel gates tint, and one invalid texel adjacent to water carries neighboring depth only to avoid coast interpolation bias

grid_summary.source: EMODnet Digital Bathymetry (DTM 2024), bathymetry_dtm_2024 ERDDAP griddap
grid_summary.coordinate_system: WGS84 longitude/latitude (EPSG:4326); runtime positions use the project GeoReference ECEF-to-ENU conversion
grid_summary.source_elevation_convention: elevation in metres relative to LAT; negative values below LAT, positive values above LAT
grid_summary.stored_value_convention: positive water depth = -elevation, quantized to 0.1 m; only finite source values below LAT are valid water cells
grid_summary.binary_record_layout: little-endian int16 depth_decimetres; uint8 interpolation_flag (0/1, 255 invalid); uint8 value_count saturated to 255 (255 invalid)
